Contract ManageSubjectCRUDService::createSubject(name: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		obs: Subject = Subject.allInstance()->select(o|o.Name = name)
	precondition:
		obs.isEmpty() = bool
	postcondition:
		let ob: Subject in
		ob.oclIsNew() and
		Subject.allInstance()->includes(ob) and
		result = obs.isEmpty()
}
